name: BLUEHOUSE DEBUT EP RELEASE
long_description:
After making strong first impressions on the Poneke live music scene, Bluehouse are finally releasing their debut EP. It's a banger of a record, with fan favourite live tracks being translated expertly into the studio, and to celebrate this huge milestone, Bluehouse are headlining their first ever show and playing a big set full of the rocking music and charming lyrics they have become known for.

Opening the night is Cordelia's, an indie-folk feminine-rage trio.

Further support acts TBA.

id: A FLOWERING BUD - SHORT FILM PREMIERE WITH 'PARK FLYERS'.-Valhalla, Wellington-Valhalla
name: A FLOWERING BUD - SHORT FILM PREMIERE WITH 'PARK FLYERS'.
long_description:
Short films need more avenues to be enjoyed than competitive festivals. Musicians don't sweat in dive bars for awards.

Watch a short art film intrude upon the gig scene; a scene where creativity is supported instead of forced to compete.

In a night of artistic alliance, three musical acts support the premiere of a young director's debut art film, 'A Flowering Bud':

Punk Soloist 'Diplopoda',

Emo Band 'Park Flyers',

and Electronic Artist 'charmort'

-- Through venomous charm and lavish gifts, a predatory landlord manipulates
and steals from his female tenant, who must realise his harm before it is too late --

Doors - 7:15 pm

Diplopoda - 7:45pm

A Flowering Bud (Short Film) - 8:20 pm

Park Flyers - 8:30 pm

charmort - 9:15 pm

Tickets here

name: MOVEMENT (SPEED ALL NIGHT)
long_description:
A Movement extravaganza featuring quick fire 30 minute sets from 7 DJs spinning hot wax all night!
Expect synth-pop, post punk funk, classic early dance, old school rap, goth classics, non stop raging dancefloor bangers!!!

Your host is DJ Matai, known for sets spanning vintage goth, new wave and post-punk. Expect to hear the classic and the obscure. Known for running DIY Punk label Razored Raw and drumming in bands such as No Sector and Maced.

with guests:

DJ Boss Dude- It's your ol' mate, thee space vampire of Newtown, thee headhoncho of Creeps record parlour, thee master of many genres, 80s electronique, synthesizer, Italo-disco, and New Wave.

DJ Shade is an 80s deep-cut enthusiast. Digging up rare gems from New Zealand alongside obscure B-sides that span electro, new wave, post punk dancefloor cuts. Expect a carefully curated set of grooves and underground energy guaranteed to move the floor.

DJ Nightmare: Three decades deep and still dragging the dancefloor into the dark — DJ Nightmare is a fixture of the scene and a genuine authority on all things goth, post-punk, industrial, cold wave, new romantic, angular electronic, neo goth and synth pop, with a blast beat or two thrown in for the brave. Expect the unexpected. Expect the dark, Expect to dance.

TV DiSKO: plumbs the deeper recesses of the globe for post-punk, dark electro, synth-pop, minimal, cold and dark wave to fill a discerning dance floor.

DJ Idle Hands- Katie is a vinyl DJ who has been playing around Pōneke for more than a decade. Expect 80s punk, cold wave, and some Continental deep cuts.

Coffin Nails: fresh type-A negative blood injected into the Wellington selecting scene. Coming with them is a breadth of genres, from iconic synth pop to the early days of hiphop, all freshly exhumed from the graves of the 80s.

Supported as always by the mates at CREEPS RECORD PARLOUR

name: BORDERLINE DESTRUCTION - A HEAVY MUSIC FESTIVAL. FT THE ASCENDED (AUS)
long_description:
Borderline Destruction - A Heavy Music Festival. ft The Ascended (Aus)

BORDERLINE DESTRUCTION – A HEAVY MUSIC FESTIVAL

New Zealand, get ready for your first taste of Borderline Destruction — a brand-new heavy music festival bringing together some of the heaviest sounds from across the ditch and beyond.

Headlining the charge are The Ascended (Melbourne, Australia), bringing their blend of crushing metalcore, soaring melodies and relentless live energy to New Zealand for the very first time.

Expect a night of heavy riffs, breakdowns and some of the best emerging and established heavy acts from New Zealand.

One stage. One massive night. No holding back.

Borderline Destruction – A Heavy Music Festival
Featuring The Ascended (AUS)
CryFor (WLG)
Synthesis of Self (AKL)
Soulstroke (AKL)
In Their Image (WLG)
Broken By Design (WLG)
